item.title: Trump to address nation at critical moment in his war with Iran
item.summary: The address comes after weeks of uncertainty over when and how the U.S. could extricate itself from the conflict.

item.title: After Israel's invasion, many in southern Lebanon worry they'll never go home
item.summary: Israel says it's creating a "security zone" inside Lebanon, where homes will be demolished, and residents won't be allowed to return home until people in northern Israel feel safe.

item.title: Israel strikes Lebanon as Trump is set to deliver a speech on the Iran war
item.summary: As Israel expands its invasion of Lebanon, the White House says President Trump will provide "an important update" to the nation on the Iran war.

item.title: A propaganda war on the National Mall pits Trump against satirical statues and posters
item.summary: The Trump administration and its critics are waging a war of images on the National Mall like none before. The president's face stares down from federal buildings while statues and posters mock him below.

item.title: Greetings from London, where a big COVID memorial holds vigil over the halls of power
item.summary: Britain's 1,640-foot-long National Covid Memorial Wall stretches along the River Thames, with over a quarter million hearts representing the lives lost during the pandemic — across from Parliament.

item.title: Republicans in Congress say they have a deal to end the record-long shutdown at DHS
item.summary: The plan would fund DHS, except for immigration enforcement, through September. Republicans would then try to fund the whole agency for three years using a tactic that would not need Democratic votes.

item.title: The FDA approves a new obesity pill, giving patients another option
item.summary: The daily pill called Foundayo got a fast track through the Food and Drug Administration. It will compete with the pill form of Wegovy as an alternative to obesity drugs given by injection.

item.title: Is the U.S. Navy ready to clear sea mines in the Persian Gulf?
item.summary: Despite the danger of sea mines, experts say that mine clearing has received minimal attention and funding from the U.S. Navy — and it's often overshadowed by more high-profile weapons systems.

item.title: Supreme Court majority seems inclined to rule against Trump on birthright citizenship
item.summary: The majority seemed skeptical of the Trump administration's argument on birthright citizenship, appearing ready to rule in favor of upholding automatic citizenship for babies born on U.S. soil.

item.title: Federal judge rules DHS illegally stripped immigration status from thousands who entered through CBP One App
item.summary: Tuesday's ruling reinstates the immigration status of those who came via CBP One and whose status was terminated.
